verdict.rationale: FreeAgent publishes a public developer API at dev.freeagent.com. It has a quick start, OAuth 2.0 access and refresh tokens, a sandbox and production endpoint, versioning via the X-Api-Version header, and per-resource endpoint docs for invoices, bank transactions and users, so a user or agent can drive the product programmatically. Probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec and no llms.txt, which weakens the AI-native, machine-readable side of the story. Missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Click **Exchange Authorization Code for Tokens** to create access and refresh tokens which can be used to access the API.
use it to test out your own app with the FreeAgent API before you implement OAuth authentication.
To use the production API (instead of the sandbox one) change the two endpoints to reference **api.freeagent.com** instead of api.sandbox.freeagent.com
You can query the API to find out which user belongs to the current token using the [Get Personal Profile User endpoint](/docs/users#get-personal-profile).
